name: promptvault-desktop

scripts.build:nsis: npm run sync && npm run icon && set ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://registry.npmmirror.com/-/binary/electron-builder-binaries/&& electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish=never
